The Magpie features a 3-way toggle for different clipping options. The up position is the “Crunch” setting. It features more compression and a dirtier overall tone than the bottom two positions. It’s great for low to medium gain sounds. The middle position is the “Boost” setting. About • Collections • Blog • Compare • Privacy Policy • Terms of Service • Submit a pedal • © 2026 PedalFilter Clear Compare ( 0 ) Back Home Mojo Hand FX Magpie Back to results Mojo Hand FX Magpie Overdrive British Blues Breaker with 3-way toggle—Crunch/Boost/Overdrive modes preserve your guitar and amp character. The Magpie is a classic British-style overdrive for players who want that little something extra while maintaining their guitar and amp's inherent character. Blues Breaker-inspired circuit with Gain, Tone, and Volume controls, plus a versatile 3-way toggle for distinct operating modes. Three clipping modes cover the full range: Crunch (up) delivers more compression and a dirtier overall tone great for low to medium gain. Boost (center) removes clipping diodes entirely for clean signal amplification perfect for pushing tube amps. Overdrive (down) provides low-gain sweetness with just a touch of edge. Running on ~15mA from 9V center-negative power or 9V battery, the Magpie delivers transparent British overdrive in a 4.8" × 2.62" × 1.55" enclosure. True bypass switching. Add color to your tone without covering up what makes your rig unique.
